pages.alt: Mia, Tavi and Sol stand beside the rebuilt Moon Lantern on the balcony after their second adventure.

pages.text:
The first evening star appeared. The same Moon Lantern that the friends had rebuilt began to shine.

A BLUE MOON picture lit up. Then a GOLD SUN picture lit up. Then the blue moon came back.
pages.subtext: Mia, Sol and Tavi watched the two pictures take turns.
pages.alt: The Moon Lantern shows a blue moon light, then a gold sun light. Mia, Tavi and Sol watch from the balcony.

pages.text:
The moon and sun lights jumped from the balcony onto the garden path. They travelled towards the Sunrise Arch.

Then the next stone stayed dark. The light could go no farther.
pages.subtext: The friends could see the lit stones, the first dark stone, and the arch at the far end of the garden.
pages.alt: Blue moon and gold sun tiles lead from the Moon Lantern to one dark turning gate. The Sunrise Arch is visible farther away.

pages.text:
Vee hurried over from the little path hut.

“Hello! I’m Vee. I look after this garden path,” Vee said. “The Sunrise Arch lights the way to the garden gate each morning, but the path has stopped. Will you help me fix it before sunrise?”
pages.subtext: The friends have one clear job: help the light reach the Sunrise Arch. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: Vee, a purple path keeper wearing large goggles, greets Mia, Tavi and Sol beside the stopped trail. The optional code TRAILLIGHT is hidden on a station sign.

pages.text:
Vee picked up one trail tile.

One side showed a BLUE MOON. The other side showed a GOLD SUN.
pages.subtext: Both sides belong to the same tile.
pages.alt: One thick trail tile is shown from both sides. One face has a blue moon symbol. The other face has a gold sun symbol.

pages.text:
Look at the tile in Vee’s hands.

Which side is showing now?

Point to the matching picture before you turn.
pages.subtext: Both answer pictures stay where you can see them. Choose before you turn.
pages.alt: Vee holds the tile with its blue moon face visible. Separate blue moon and gold sun answer pictures wait above the scene.

pages.badge: THE BLUE MOON SIDE IS SHOWING
pages.text:
BLUE MOON SIDE SHOWING.
GOLD SUN SIDE UNDERNEATH.

The two side names help us keep the sides apart.
pages.subtext: A side name tells us which face we are looking at. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The visible blue moon face and the hidden gold sun face are both labelled. The optional code TWOSIDES is hidden on the table edge.

pages.text:
The first gate was stuck. Vee put the tile inside with its BLUE MOON side facing up.

Sol pulled the curved handle. The gate turned the tile over one time.
pages.subtext: Watch what happens before naming the side that comes out.
pages.alt: A blue moon tile enters a simple turning gate. One curved arrow shows one turn.

pages.text:
Put one hand flat like the tile.

Turn your hand over one time.

Which side of Vee’s tile will show after one turn?
pages.subtext: Choose the blue moon or the gold sun before you turn the page.
pages.alt: The blue moon tile is halfway through the turning gate. Blue moon and gold sun choices wait above it.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON turned to GOLD SUN.

One turn changed which side was showing.
pages.subtext: The blue moon side still belongs to the tile. It is now underneath.
pages.alt: A before picture shows the blue moon face. An after picture shows the gold sun face after one turn.

pages.text:
The GOLD SUN side is showing now.

The next gate will turn the tile one more time.

Which side will show next?
pages.subtext: Use your hand again. Choose before you turn the page.
pages.alt: The gold sun tile waits before a second turning gate. Blue moon and gold sun choices are both visible.

pages.text:
GOLD SUN turned to BLUE MOON.

The first side came back.
pages.subtext: Return means the earlier side is showing again.
pages.alt: A gold sun face turns through the second gate and the blue moon face appears again. Both stages are labelled.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON → GOLD SUN.
GOLD SUN → BLUE MOON.

One turn changes the side. The next turn brings the first side back.
pages.subtext: Say the moves with Mia: turn, then return. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: Two large labelled arrows show blue moon turning to gold sun, then gold sun returning to blue moon. The optional code TURNBACK is hidden beside one arrow.

pages.text:
Point as the lights take turns:

BLUE MOON · GOLD SUN · BLUE MOON · GOLD SUN
pages.subtext: Go slowly from left to right. Each light follows the same turn-and-return rule.
pages.alt: Four large tiles form one row: blue moon, gold sun, blue moon, gold sun.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON · GOLD SUN · BLUE MOON · GOLD SUN · ?

Which light follows the rule?
pages.subtext: Choose before you turn. Vee keeps both choices visible.
pages.alt: Blue moon, gold sun, blue moon and gold sun appear before one empty place. Separate blue moon and gold sun choices wait above it.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON comes next.

A PATTERN is a rule that tells us what move comes next.
pages.subtext: This pattern follows the turn-and-return rule the friends just used. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The fifth place is filled by a blue moon tile. The complete row and its turn-and-return rule are labelled.

pages.text: The repaired gate lit the next garden stones. Sol hurried ahead and turned one tile the wrong way. Two blue moons met, and the light stopped again.
pages.subtext: The friends left Sol’s whole first try in place so they could see what happened.
pages.alt: Sol stands beside a stopped trail showing blue moon, gold sun, blue moon, blue moon. No tile has been removed.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON · GOLD SUN · BLUE MOON · BLUE MOON

Point to the first tile that does not follow the rule.
pages.subtext: Start at the left and check one move at a time before you turn.
pages.alt: Four large trail tiles remain visible. The fourth tile repeats blue moon instead of changing to gold sun.

pages.badge: THE FOURTH TILE BREAKS THE RULE
pages.text:
The fourth tile should show GOLD SUN.

Sol’s BLUE MOON tile stays in the picture so we can see what happened.
pages.subtext: A broken rule means one shown move does not follow the declared rule.
pages.alt: The fourth blue moon tile is labelled first try. A gold sun tile beside it is labelled the tile required by the rule.

pages.badge: KEEP THE TRY, REPAIR THE TRAIL
pages.text:
Sol turned the fourth tile to GOLD SUN. The light moved forward.

“We kept the first try,” said Tavi. “Then we repaired the move.”
pages.subtext: The trail now reads blue moon, gold sun, blue moon, gold sun. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The repaired four-tile trail glows. A small picture of Sol’s first try remains beside it. The optional code KEEPTHETRY is hidden on the picture frame.

pages.text:
The light reached a bridge.

One lamp travelled OVER the arch. The next lamp travelled UNDER the arch.
pages.subtext: Over and under are new names. The path still changes from one to the other after every move.
pages.alt: One light travels over a small arch and the next light travels under it. Both routes are clearly labelled.

pages.badge: TRY IT · CHOOSE THE NEXT WAY
pages.text:
OVER · UNDER · OVER · ?

Which way comes next if over and under keep taking turns?
pages.subtext: Choose over or under before you turn the page.
pages.alt: Three labelled route pictures show over, under and over, followed by one empty place. Over and under choices remain separate.

pages.text:
OVER · UNDER · OVER · UNDER

The pictures and names changed, but the take-turns rule stayed the same.
pages.subtext: The light can now cross the whole bridge. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The fourth route picture is labelled under. The complete over-under-over-under route glows. The optional code OVERUNDER is hidden under the bridge rail.

pages.text:
Three short light trails waited at the last gate.

One stopped early. One broke the rule. One followed the rule all the way.
pages.subtext: The team needs a route that reaches the arch and takes turns all the way.
pages.alt: Route A has only three tiles and stops. Route B repeats a blue moon tile. Route C alternates blue moon and gold sun all the way to the arch.

pages.badge: TRY IT · CHOOSE THE WHOLE ROUTE
pages.text:
Look at Route A, Route B and Route C.

Which route reaches the Sunrise Arch and follows every turn?
pages.subtext: Point to one route before you turn the page.
pages.alt: All three route choices remain visible: a short route, a broken alternation and a complete alternating route to the Sunrise Arch.

pages.text:
ROUTE C follows every turn and reaches the Sunrise Arch.

The light travelled across the repaired trail.
pages.subtext: The light can now travel across the whole garden. Find the optional code.
labels: C · EVERY MOVE FOLLOWS THE RULE
pages.alt: Route C glows from the Moon Lantern to the Sunrise Arch. Routes A and B remain visible as rejected attempts. The optional code RIGHTROUTE is hidden on the arch base.

pages.text:
At the first gate, BLUE MOON went in. The gate turned the tile once.

Which side came out?
pages.subtext: Think back to the first gate. Choose the picture you remember.
pages.alt: A small memory picture shows the blue moon tile entering the first gate. Blue moon and gold sun answer pictures wait above the Sunrise Arch.

pages.text:
BLUE MOON turned to GOLD SUN.

You brought an earlier move back to mind.
pages.subtext: The before and after pictures show the same one-turn change again.
pages.alt: The memory picture is complete: blue moon enters the gate and gold sun leaves it.

pages.badge: TRY THE RULE WITH NEW PICTURES
pages.text:
STAR · LEAF · STAR · ?

The pictures are new. The take-turns rule stays the same. Which picture comes next?
pages.subtext: Choose star or leaf before you turn.
pages.alt: A new row shows a star, a leaf and a star followed by one empty place. Separate star and leaf choices remain visible.

pages.text:
STAR · LEAF · STAR · LEAF

The pictures changed. The take-turns rule stayed the same. The Sunrise Arch lit up!
pages.subtext: Tell the journey: name both pictures, make one move, check what happened, and repair the first move that broke the rule. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The star-leaf-star-leaf row is complete beneath the glowing Sunrise Arch. The optional code NEWROLES is hidden among carved leaves.

pages.text:
The path was ready before sunrise. The arch lit the way to the garden gate. Vee kept Sol’s first-try picture beside the repaired map.

Tavi looked at both pictures. “Next time, can a friend check our work too?”
pages.subtext: Next: Book E04 · Look Again: How We Check
pages.alt: Mia, Tavi, Sol and Vee watch the morning light reach the Sunrise Arch. The preserved first-try picture sits beside the repaired trail map.
